newsitem.title: USA: Entergy 858 MW Ark. nuke power plant shut.
newsitem.headline: Entergy 858 MW Ark. nuke power plant shut.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 858 megawatt Arkansas nuclear power unit 2 was shut over the weekend to repair a steam generator tube leak, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Russellville, Ark. unit was shut Nov 16 for the repairs, and was expected to return to service Dec 7, the NRC said Monday in its daily plant status report.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to comment on the outage.
The adjacent 836 megawatt Arkansas nuclear power unit 1 was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Monday, the NRC said in the report.
